snippet.title: The Sinking City Remastered - Comparison & Launch Trailer
snippet.description: The Sinking City Remastered is out now on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S, fully rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver the ultimate Lovecraftian experience! Free upgrade for players who already own the original game version released specifically for PC, PlayStation 5, or Xbox Series X|S.
